title: podman pod logs: clarify container requirement and update help for remote
body:
<!--
Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines;
https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
When running `podman pod logs` remotely (via `podman-remote`, or against a remote podman service on macOS/Windows), retrieving logs across all containers in a pod is not supported due to REST API limitations. Consequently, passing `-c` / `--container` is mandatory when remote.

However, the `--help` text previously showed examples that omit `-c`, the flag description did not mention that `-c` is required remotely, and the resulting error message (`-c or --container cannot be empty: invalid argument`) was confusing to users who never specified `-c` in the first place.

Update `podLogsCommand` to:
- Show remote-appropriate examples when `registry.IsRemote()` is true
- Note in the flag description and man page that `-c` is required when run remotely
- Clarify the error message to specify that `-c or --container` is required when running remotely
- Add unit and e2e test coverage

#### How to verify it:
Run `./bin/podman-remote pod logs --help` and verify the examples and flag description.
Run unit tests: `go test -v ./cmd/podman/pods ./pkg/domain/infra/tunnel`.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #30143

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
None

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?
```release-note
Update `podman pod logs --help`, man page, and error messages to clarify that `-c / --container` is required when running remotely.
```
